summary:

- Appended "2026-08-24 OK" to logs/test.log (preserving existing 2026-08-23 entry).
- Created logs/deploy.log containing "2026-08-24 OK".
- Wrote "3" to logs/count.txt.

[Key values]
- 2026-08-24 OK
- logs/build.log
- logs/test.log
- logs/deploy.log

[Decisions]

[Issues]
- The user's specified date (2026-08-24) does not match the current system date (2026-11-03); the user was informed and offered the option to change the entries.

[Next]
